definitions.explanation: Water that has been heated to or near its boiling point. Used in cooking instructions, food preparation, and safety warnings.

examples.japanese: {熱湯|ねっとう}を{注|そそ}いでください。
カップ{麺|めん}に{熱湯|ねっとう}を{入|い}れて3{分|ぷん}{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: Pour boiling water into the cup noodles and wait three minutes.

examples.japanese: {熱湯|ねっとう}でやけどしないように{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful not to burn yourself with the boiling water.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on instant food packaging and in cooking instructions. Distinct from {お湯|おゆ} (hot water), which can refer to water of any warm temperature. {熱湯|ねっとう} specifically means water at or very near 100°C.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱湯|ねっとう}を{注|そそ}ぐ: to pour boiling water
- {熱湯|ねっとう}を{沸|わ}かす: to bring water to a boil
- {熱湯|ねっとう}{消毒|しょうどく}: sterilization with boiling water
- {熱湯|ねっとう}に{通|とお}す: to blanch in boiling water
